logicalTable.name: Product AI Signals
logicalTable.description: Store-SKU-week AI score signals from FASHIONDW.PRODUCT_AI_SCORE_LABELED_V, including sales, inventory movement, lost-sales, risk, and recommended-action evidence.

logicalColumns.name: SKU Week Case ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden technical identifier for one store-SKU-week AI signal case.

logicalColumns.name: Week Start Date
logicalColumns.description: Week represented by the AI signal case. Include this field when you need to see the exact timing of an exception rather than an average across multiple weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Date Key
logicalColumns.description: Hidden date key used to join the AI signal case to the Date dimension.

logicalColumns.name: Store ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden store key used to join the AI signal case to the Store dimension.

logicalColumns.name: SKU ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden SKU key used to join the AI signal case to the Product dimension.

logicalColumns.name: Style ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden style key carried from the product hierarchy for the AI signal case.

logicalColumns.name: Collection ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden collection key used to join the AI signal case to the Collection dimension.

logicalColumns.name: Cluster ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden cluster key assigned by the product behavior clustering model.

logicalColumns.name: Business Phenomenon
logicalColumns.description: Business-facing classification of the AI case, such as stockout risk, overstock, return or fit risk, margin pressure, or unexplained anomaly.

logicalColumns.name: Reason Code
logicalColumns.description: Compact reason label explaining the main driver behind the AI case. Use it to group similar exceptions without reading the longer evidence text.

logicalColumns.name: Recommended Action
logicalColumns.description: Short operational action suggested for the individual store-SKU-week AI case.

logicalColumns.name: Cluster Label
logicalColumns.description: Descriptive label for the behavior cluster assigned to the AI case. Use it to group cases with similar sales, inventory, return, and risk patterns.

logicalColumns.name: Business Interpretation
logicalColumns.description: Plain-language interpretation of what the assigned AI signal or cluster means for the business.

logicalColumns.name: Recommended Business Action
logicalColumns.description: Longer business action guidance associated with the signal or cluster; useful for dashboard detail panes and AI-assisted explanations.

logicalColumns.name: Model Evidence
logicalColumns.description: Model-oriented explanation of the features, scores, or probabilities that influenced the AI case classification.

logicalColumns.name: Business Evidence
logicalColumns.description: Business-readable explanation of the sales, inventory, return, margin, or risk signals supporting the AI case.

logicalColumns.name: Cluster Evidence Summary
logicalColumns.description: Summary of the behaviors that characterize the assigned cluster, such as demand, sell-through, markdown, returns, stockout risk, or overstock risk.

logicalColumns.name: Scenario Tag
logicalColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

logicalColumns.name: Fulfilled Units Sold
logicalColumns.description: Units actually sold and fulfilled in the store-SKU-week AI case. It reconciles to core sales quantity at the same grain; use it beside estimated demand and estimated lost sales to understand constrained demand.

logicalColumns.name: Full Price Units
logicalColumns.description: Full-price units observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as evidence of demand quality when investigating an AI signal.

logicalColumns.name: Net Sales Amount
logicalColumns.description: Net sales observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as impact evidence for an exception; use core Sales KPIs for standard revenue reporting.

logicalColumns.name: Gross Margin Amount
logicalColumns.description: Gross margin observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to judge whether an exception is commercially important.

logicalColumns.name: Returned Units
logicalColumns.description: Returned units observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as fit, quality, or return-risk evidence within the AI signal workflow.

logicalColumns.name: On Hand Units
logicalColumns.description: On-hand inventory in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as context for the signal; use Inventory KPIs for operational inventory reporting.

logicalColumns.name: Available Units
logicalColumns.description: Available inventory in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to understand whether an AI case has sellable stock at the time of the signal.

logicalColumns.name: Opening On Hand Units
logicalColumns.description: Opening physical stock on hand for the store-SKU-week AI case. Use with Week Start Date when reviewing the inventory flow that led to an exception; avoid treating it as a pure cumulative KPI across many weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Ending On Hand Units
logicalColumns.description: Ending physical stock on hand for the store-SKU-week AI case. Use it to understand the post-sales stock position after replenishment, transfers, and fulfilled sales.

logicalColumns.name: Ending Available Units
logicalColumns.description: Ending sellable units for the store-SKU-week AI case after reservations. This is the clearest AI-signal field for seeing whether a store still had available stock at the end of the week.

logicalColumns.name: Replenishment Units
logicalColumns.description: Units received through replenishment for the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to see whether the business tried to restore supply before an exception emerged.

logicalColumns.name: Transfer In Units
logicalColumns.description: Units transferred into the store for the store-SKU-week AI case. This supports investigation of cross-store inventory actions, especially for stockout stories.

logicalColumns.name: Transfer Out Units
logicalColumns.description: Units transferred out of the store for the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to understand whether inventory was moved away from the store before or during an exception.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Demand Units
logicalColumns.description: Estimated unconstrained customer demand represented by the store-SKU-week AI case, equal to fulfilled units sold plus estimated lost sales units. This is modeled demand evidence, not a directly observed POS count.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Units
logicalColumns.description: Estimated demand units that could not be fulfilled because available stock was exhausted. Positive values indicate missed demand rather than normal low sales.

logicalColumns.name: Fulfilled Estimated Demand Percent
logicalColumns.description: Percentage of estimated demand that was fulfilled in the store-SKU-week AI case. Low values indicate demand was constrained by availability.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Rate Percent
logicalColumns.description: Percentage of estimated demand that became estimated lost sales in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use it to rank stockout severity independently from fulfilled sales.

logicalColumns.name: Supply Units
logicalColumns.description: Opening stock plus inbound supply less transfer-out units for the store-SKU-week AI case. This helps explain the stock position before fulfilled sales are deducted.

logicalColumns.name: Net Inventory Change Units
logicalColumns.description: Change in on-hand units from opening to ending inventory for the store-SKU-week AI case. Negative values show depletion; positive values show net inventory build-up.

logicalColumns.name: Replenishment Event Cases
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI cases where replenishment or transfer-in activity occurred. Use it to see whether supply actions preceded or accompanied an exception.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Stockout Cases
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI cases where ending available stock is zero and estimated lost sales were recorded. This is stricter evidence than a zero-availability snapshot alone.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Demand Units 4W Avg
logicalColumns.description: Four-week average estimated demand units used by the AI signal layer. It captures recent demand momentum, including missed demand when stock is exhausted.

logicalColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Units 4W Sum
logicalColumns.description: Rolling four-week estimated lost-sales evidence used by the AI signal layer. Use it to distinguish repeated missed demand from a one-week issue.

logicalColumns.name: Full Price Unit Share 4W Avg
logicalColumns.description: Four-week average full-price unit share used by the AI signal layer. It helps separate healthy full-price demand from markdown-driven movement.

logicalColumns.name: Markdown Percent
logicalColumns.description: Markdown percent used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Gross Margin Percent
logicalColumns.description: Gross margin percent used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Return Rate Percent
logicalColumns.description: Return rate percent used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Full Price Sell Through Percent
logicalColumns.description: Full-price sell-through percent used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Full Price Unit Share Percent

expressionObjects: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Full Price Units
logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Fulfilled Units Sold

logicalColumns.description: Full-price unit share used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Sell Through Percent
logicalColumns.description: Sell-through percent used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Stockout Store Rate Percent
logicalColumns.description: Store stockout rate used as an AI signal feature.

logicalColumns.name: Average Weeks Of Supply
logicalColumns.description: Weeks-of-supply feature used by the AI signal layer.

logicalColumns.name: Demand Index 4W
logicalColumns.description: Short-term demand index used by the AI signal layer.

logicalColumns.name: Demand Index 13W
logicalColumns.description: Longer-term demand index used by the AI signal layer.

logicalColumns.name: Stockout Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Average store-SKU-week stockout risk across the selected AI cases. Useful for context, but for exception severity prefer Latest Stockout Risk Score, Peak Stockout Risk Score, or Affected Stockout Weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Overstock Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Average store-SKU-week overstock risk across the selected AI cases. Useful for context, but for exception severity prefer Latest Overstock Risk Score, Peak Overstock Risk Score, or Affected Overstock Weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Anomaly Prediction
logicalColumns.description: Hidden model output indicating whether the store-SKU-week case is predicted to be anomalous.

logicalColumns.name: Anomaly Count
logicalColumns.description: Count of cases flagged as anomalous.

logicalColumns.name: Anomaly Probability
logicalColumns.description: Probability that the store-SKU-week case is unusual compared with learned product behavior.

logicalColumns.name: Business Exception Score
logicalColumns.description: Highest business exception score across the selected AI cases. Use this to rank store-SKU-week exceptions by actionability and commercial impact.

logicalColumns.name: Typical Probability
logicalColumns.description: Probability that the store-SKU-week case is typical compared with learned product behavior.

logicalColumns.name: Cluster Probability
logicalColumns.description: Model confidence that the store-SKU-week case belongs to its assigned behavior cluster.

logicalColumns.name: Primary Feature ID
logicalColumns.description: Hidden technical identifier for the model feature that most influenced the AI case. Use Model Evidence or Business Evidence for business-facing explanations.

logicalColumns.name: Primary Feature Value
logicalColumns.description: Numeric value of the feature that most influenced the AI case; mainly useful for diagnostics alongside the evidence fields.

logicalColumns.name: Stockout Alert Cases
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI cases classified as stockout alerts. This is stricter than a zero-inventory count because it requires the case to meet the stockout risk and demand conditions used by the AI signal layer.

logicalColumns.name: Overstock Alert Cases
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI cases classified as overstock alerts. This is an exception case count, not a raw count of products with inventory on hand.

logicalColumns.name: Margin Alert Count
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI signal cases classified as margin alerts.

logicalColumns.name: Return Alert Count
logicalColumns.description: Count of AI signal cases classified as return alerts.

logicalColumns.name: Action Priority
logicalColumns.description: Priority score used to order recommended business actions.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Stockout Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw store-SKU-week stockout risk score used by latest and peak exception measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Overstock Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw store-SKU-week overstock risk score used by latest and peak exception measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Stockout Alert Flag
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw stockout alert flag used to count affected weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Overstock Alert Flag
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw overstock alert flag used to count affected weeks.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Business Exception Score
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw business exception score used by latest exception measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Demand Units
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw demand units used by latest-week movement evidence measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Lost Sales Units
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw lost-sales units used by latest-week movement evidence measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Ending On Hand Units
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw ending on-hand units used by latest-week inventory evidence measures.

logicalColumns.name: Raw Ending Available Units
logicalColumns.description: Hidden raw ending available units used by latest-week inventory evidence measures.

logicalColumns.name: Peak Stockout Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Highest stockout risk score reached by the selected AI cases across all included weeks. Use this to rank severity without diluting short but important stockout episodes.

logicalColumns.name: Peak Overstock Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Highest overstock risk score reached by the selected AI cases across all included weeks. Use this to rank severity without diluting short but important overstock episodes.

logicalColumns.name: Latest Stockout Risk Score
logicalColumns.description: Highest stockout risk score in the latest week available for the selected AI cases. Use this when the current state matters more than historical average risk.

logicalExpression.expressionTemplate: EVALUATE_AGGR('MAX(\%1) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY \%2)' AS DOUBLE, %1, %2)
expressionObjects: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Raw Stockout Risk Score
logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Week Start Date
